basic_info.main_problem: 我一直觉得自己在制作婚礼蛋糕方面的skill并not特do not，因为任何人通过练习都可以掌握这些skill。这种思维模式让我对自己的能力产生怀疑，降低了我的成就感。
basic_info.core_demands: 这些想法已经影响了我在烘焙中的动力和创造力，阻碍了我的Career development和Work乐趣，因此希望通过咨询改善自我认知，承认并看到自己在制作婚礼蛋糕方面的价值与独特性。
growth_experiences: 在开始烘焙职业生涯的期间（制作婚礼蛋糕），因为同事的一次反馈而对自己的skill产生怀疑；之后常与行业内他人比较，导致Self-doubt worsens、对作品满意度下降；在Handling wedding cake orders时以及Receiving client feedback后，这种模式尤为明显。曾尝试通过参加烘焙Work坊、寻求客户认可来缓解，但效果有限。
在Student时期曾于去年赢得一次科学展项目的奖项。当时因对项目抱有强烈兴趣而投入大量时间研究与制作，专注于自身任务而非与他人比较，体验到自豪与能力感。

core_beliefs: My worth needs external recognition to hold

special_situations.event: After starting wedding-cake work, receives feedback from colleagues
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果do not人指出我的not足或提出修改建议，就说明I am not good enough、我的skillnot特do not
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Attends baking workshops and doubles practice to prove oneself
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 任何人练习都能做到，我并have not什么特do not之处

special_situations.event: In the context of handling wedding cake orders and receiving client feedback
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果客户提出任何改动或非完全赞美，就意味着我的作品not够好
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 频繁寻求客户的认可与肯定，以缓解not安
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 客户可能not喜欢我的作品

special_situations.event: Sees works and achievements of others in the industry and compares
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我的表现not及他人，就证明I have no value和独特性
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 回避与朋友谈及Self-doubt，独自加练以期赶上他人

special_situations.event: In academic evaluation situations (exams, grade announcements), sees classmates performing better
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果成绩not如他人，就说明I am not smart enough、not能力
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 更努力Learning、向老师求助，但同时继续negate自己的成就
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not smart enough，可能not适合这条路

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be seen and recognized, expecting one's unique value to be acknowledged by others
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被negate、被比较后显得普通与not够好，从而失去价值感
defense_goal: 通过理性化与寻求外部验证来降低Anxiety并维持可控的自我形象
When facing compliments, downplays the positive side to avoid the ensuing pressure and possible disappointment

object_relations.self_representation: 普通且not够好的从业者/Learning者
object_relations.object_representation: 挑剔、带有negate倾向的评判者（同事/客户）
A group of smarter, better classmates

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When others give praise or positive feedback on one's works or performance
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 倾向认为赞美not真实或只是礼节性寒暄，难以内化为自我价值（移情：将他人视为not真诚的评判者）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: In a rational, steady tone downplays praise, emphasizing 'anyone who practices can do it', and turns the conversation toward objective procedures or technical details.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When receiving neutral or constructive client/colleague feedback
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将中性反馈理解为negate或拒绝，体验到被批评的感觉（移情：他人被视为苛刻的评判者）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气防御、简短回应，强调对方“可能not喜欢”，并迅速寻求更多外部肯定以平复not安。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When seeing peers / others in the industry with better results and comparing
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将Self-deprecation视为事实，认为自己永远not如他人（移情：他人被视为not可企及的标准）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use自责语气表达“我not行”，降低自我期望，避免谈及自身优点或过去成功。

exception_events.reason: 线索：因为对项目有强烈兴趣与投入（not同做法），专注于过程而非比较（not同理解），因此这次出现了更好的结果与自我效能体验。
